scope: Eleven native graph/multiscale model profiles; caller-prepared inputs; no shared trainer or automatic graph/multiscale preparation
source_policy: Pinned working trees in upstream remain unmodified. Exact replacements fail if the pinned source text changes. Commit and license provenance lives in compat/sources/<repository>.json.
validation: Synthetic CPU train forward, finite nonzero parameter gradients, strict adapter state_dict reload, and native eval forward for every profile. Additional native checkpoint, H2 hierarchy/width, HIPT variant and GFR survival checks. No real slides, pretrained weights, external inference or paper-performance reproduction.

wikg.inputs: One feature bag [N,D]; N must be at least topk
repairs: Remove import-time global anomaly-detection mutation
wikg.preserved: Native dynamic top-k knowledge graph, configured aggregation/readout and classifier

tad_graph.inputs: One prepared PyG graph with x, COO edge_index and normalized distance/angle edge_attr [E,2] in [0,1]
repairs: Forward-only nn.Module base replaces its training-framework base, preserving hparams/current_epoch/logged metrics without defining a trainer
Private COO adjacency representation and equivalent Torch/PyG scatter and transpose operations avoid optional compiled sparse extensions
Keep COO edge descriptors aligned across native self-loop insertion and transpose
Bind public MessagePassing dispatcher for the native custom edge_atten argument on current PyG
Clone weighted graph inputs before causal/trivial evaluation to prevent native in-place feature corruption
Wire requested attention_head_num consistently into native convolution heads/widths and honor eval mode in functional dropout
When learn_edge_att is selected, apply edge scores to edges without also multiplying them into node rows
Construct edge embeddings on the feature device; remove optional debugger and dataset-path imports
tad_graph.preserved: Native DenseGNN/GATv2 modules, causal extractor, stochastic attention sampler, causal and trivial forward paths and information loss
tad_graph.outputs: Classification: causal logits/class probabilities, trivial logits and differentiable info_loss. Survival task: sigmoid hazards, cumulative survival, risk=-sum(survival), trivial logits/hazards in aux and probabilities=None. Original native tuple retained.

resgat.inputs: One prepared PyG graph with x and COO edge_index
resgat.preserved: All three native residual GATv2/GraphNorm blocks, mean pooling and classifier; no DGL replacement required

patch_gcn.inputs: One prepared PyG graph; edge_agg chooses edge_index or caller-supplied edge_latent
repairs: Use requested num_features/hidden_dim for the native initial projection instead of hardcoded 1024/128 or 256
Size concatenated projections, attention and classifier by hidden_dim*num_layers instead of hardcoded four stages
Replace CUDA FloatTensor conversion in the optional edge-normalization helper with device-preserving float()
patch_gcn.preserved: Native GENConv/DeepGCN layers, concatenated stages, gated attention and discrete survival output
patch_gcn.outputs: Exact pre-sigmoid classifier logits captured by a temporary hook; native hazards and survival in aux; hazards are not softmax class probabilities

slidegraph_plus.inputs: One caller-prepared clustered graph with x and COO edge_index
repairs: Omit unused plotting import from native utility module
slidegraph_plus.preserved: Released train.py EdgeConv/aggr=max/mean-pooling configuration is the profile default and primary CPU acceptance case. Explicit GINConv remains available. Native per-layer graph-score aggregation, node scores and node embeddings retained; no automatic clustering

cs_mil.inputs: cluster_num tensors [P_i,D,3,1], three explicitly paired scales per patch; optional binary mask [1,sum(P_i)] with at least one active patch
repairs: Use model parameter device/dtype instead of unconditional CUDA conversion
Expose input channel width and sigmoid-head count while retaining native defaults 2048 and one
Exponentiate masked logits and clamp normalization denominator for stable native masked softmax
cs_mil.preserved: Shared native convolutional patch encoder, resolution-attention fusion, bag attention and sigmoid classifier
cs_mil.outputs: Native sigmoid values retained; exact pre-sigmoid logits captured; multiple explicitly requested heads remain independent sigmoids

zoommil.inputs: Three native parent-major feature levels, with integer child ratios; no inferred cross-scale mappings
repairs: Create Kronecker identity tensors on input device/dtype instead of CUDA-detecting stored device
Correct native PerturbedTopKFunction backward return arity from six to four entries, matching apply(x,k,num_samples,sigma)
zoommil.preserved: All three native attention streams, train-time perturbation-gradient estimator, eval hard selection, summed multiscale bag embedding and classifier

hag_mil.entry_point: models/model.py:IATModel plus main.py three-stage selection cascade
hag_mil.inputs: Three parent-major feature levels with exactly four contiguous children per parent
repairs: Extract the existing three-scale forward/selection orchestration without importing the training script
Pass model constructor arguments by their actual keyword signature instead of the script's configuration dictionary positional mismatch
Use reshape(-1) for attention ordering so singleton selections remain index vectors
hag_mil.preserved: Three independent native IATModel networks, their Nyström/Admin blocks, attention-based four-child zoom selection and optional native instance losses
hag_mil.outputs: Finest-stage standard output; all native stage tuples and selected indices retained in aux. Hard selection does not backpropagate through indices; stage objectives remain caller-owned.

gfr_mil.inputs: features/coords, high_features/high_coords, and one explicit long region_labels parent index per high feature
gfr_mil.preserved: Existing exact native adapter, stochastic training selection/recycling, rotary region transformer, fine class attention and auxiliary attention loss; upstream already provides its CPU attention fallback
gfr_mil.constraints: Native coordinate quantization remains high //448 and low //3584. Native depth/selection behavior is retained.
gfr_mil.outputs: Classification or survival task selectable; capture exact classifier logits because upstream survival adapter labels hazards as logits; native output dictionary retained

h2_mil.inputs: One root/coarse/fine ordered PyG hierarchy: x, edge_index_tree_8nb, node_type 0/1/2, node_tree parents, normalized x_y_index; every coarse parent has fine children
repairs: Remove import-time CUDA visibility mutation
Omit unused plotting import from training entry module
Use separate width-correct native PyG LayerNorm modules at input, convolution and halved classifier stages
Replace optional extension reductions with equivalent PyG/Torch scatter and remove unused sparse/private imports
Derive temporary tensor device from input features in RAConv and IHPool
Bind current PyG MessagePassing dispatcher for native custom message parameters
Make final class count explicit while retaining default four; convert softmax segment size to a Python integer
h2_mil.preserved: Both native resolution-aware convolutions, both spatial/fitness IHPool stages, pooled cluster/type/tree/score/coordinate/edge tuples and final softmax
h2_mil.checkpoint_policy: Requested native checkpoint loading is strict. Historical norm keys/shapes require explicit user migration; no silent strict=False loading.
h2_mil.limits: One graph per call; native pooling still builds dense adjacency and uses discrete hierarchy selection. CPU compatibility does not remove native quadratic memory cost.

hipt.inputs: LGP: raster-ordered [regions,256,384] patch embeddings; GP: [regions,192] region embeddings; None: grouped [regions,patches,D]
repairs: Remove cwd-relative sys.path mutation and unconditional GP debugger
Remove only the native constructor's patch-count print
Construct native modules on CPU without calling CUDA-detecting relocate()
Load explicit local teacher/full/global checkpoints strictly and fail for missing or incompatible files
Replace undefined pretrain_WSI/global_vit branch with an explicit checkpoint for the existing native global_phi/global_transformer/global_attn_pool/global_rho pipeline
Honor local/global freeze options
For GP/LGP retain their actual 192-wide native global architecture even when historical big is requested; record requested_size and effective_global_width explicitly
hipt.preserved: Native local region transformer, native global transformer/attention hierarchy, and separate no-transformer ablation; original five-element prediction tuples retained
hipt.weight_policy: Random initialization is explicit metadata when no checkpoint is supplied. No pretrained model download. The standalone raw-image HIPT_4K extraction utility is outside this feature-input MIL profile.
